text: The file name gives the family version, so this document is version 3; the source reading of Version 1 and Date 28 October 2026 is kept in a Source version row and in the change log.
why: The metadata table reads version 1 while the file name reads v2, so the next version cannot be read from the metadata table alone.
read: WP B-CTRL-33; Template and Rules R8.1 and R8.2; source metadata table; source file name
applied_in: Metadata table, Source version row; Change log
impact: Document control only; no record value changes.

text: The decision log is kept in rwb_decision, in the append-only decision_log_entry table and the central ledger, with the local decision record of the owning service; no copy goes to a data lake.
why: The data lake is removed by Architecture v5 and the reporting read model is built from events, so the archive rule of the source has no target as written.
read: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 37; plan DP-17, DP-03; ADR-018, ADR-022; Ownership Map v1
applied_in: Section 1, Decision log row; sections 2.1 and 3.1
impact: The 10-year period and the reason are unchanged; only the archive destination changes.

text: Scores (DP11) are read from the ACE view v_ace_score through rwb-source-data and are not stored in a Workbench schema; the 2-year delete period stands and is applied by the ACE owner of the view.
why: No table in the Physical Schema v6 carries DP11 and no service schema is named for it, so the row cannot be placed in a schema of its own.
read: Logical Data Model v8 LOV-DATA-PRODUCT DP11 and DF-ACE-270 to DF-ACE-279; Physical Schema v6; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 41
impact: The period and the delete action are kept; the owner of the delete is the ACE view owner, not a Workbench service.

text: Tables with no data-product row keep no retention period in this version; the source schedule covers data products and document types only, as DL26 asks.
why: A period for the operations, reporting and agent tables is not in any run source, and a period may not be invented.
read: Template and Rules R9; DL26; Logical Data Model v8 subject areas OPS, RPT and AGT
applied_in: Section 1.1, rows rwb_integration, rwb_reporting and rwb_agent; section 7
impact: Three schema rows carry the placeholder; no period is stated for those tables.

text: A legal hold on a party or on a document is recorded on the case in recovery_case.legal_hold and applied by the P5 retention job, which excludes the documents of a held case.
why: The target has no hold flag on a party or a document and no operation places such a hold, while the source allows a hold on either.
read: Physical Schema v6 recovery_case.legal_hold and status_before_hold; Ownership Map v1 POST /cases/{caseId}/legal-hold; FSD P5 v3 A2.17 acceptance criteria
impact: The three hold rules of the source stand; the place of the hold is the case.

text: The retention job of P5 decides and the owner of each schema archives or destroys its own rows; until an expiry event is in the event catalog, the request goes over the owner's REST contract, one hop with a 2 s timeout.
why: No service may write another service's tables and no expiry operation or event exists in the catalogs.
read: plan DP-01, DP-11; ADR-014, ADR-020; Ownership Map v1 retention ruling; API Specification v4; Event and Messaging Design v4
impact: The four steps and the monthly cadence stand; the acting party is the schema owner.

text: The access-log period stays per the bank security standard and its archive rule stays; the store behind GET /admin/access-log belongs to P4 rwb-access and is not in the Physical Schema v6.
why: The bank standard is not in the run documents and no access-log table is declared, so neither the period nor the store can be stated more precisely.
read: Source access-log row; Ownership Map v1 GET /admin/access-log; Physical Schema v6
applied_in: Section 1, Access log row; section 1.1 row rwb_access
impact: The period and the archive rule are unchanged; only the owner is new.

text: The retention class LAKE_COPY of retention_rule is retired with the data lake; the exclusion of decision_log_entry and the JOB-14 hash-chain check stay.
why: The class describes a copy that no longer exists, while the decision log must still be excluded from the monthly job.
read: Physical Schema v6 comments on retention_rule.record_class and table_name; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 37 and 44; ADR-018
impact: No record value changes; one class value leaves the reference data.

text: Each data product is placed in the schema of the tables that carry it, read from the Ownership Map v1; a record whose data product is under two owners is named against both schemas.
why: No source maps DP01 to DP14 to the 19 schemas, and the target table must state one schema per row to be usable.
read: Ownership Map v1 Tables sheet; plan ownership.json; Logical Data Model v8 data product per table
impact: Every owner is a service code of the Ownership Map; no period changes.

text: This version is issued in Draft; no approval is recorded for it.

impact: The document can be used for build and review; approval comes later.

read: AGENTS.md rule 10; Template and Rules R8.1; DL48
